paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
caption: The results of layer-wise quantized pruning on Llama-3-8B-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. We use 4 KV token 4-bit as baseline and report the relative change. Configurations are modified every 4 layers for the initial and final layers, while intermediate layers are reconfigured every 8 layers.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relative change in performance of layer-wise quantized pruning configurations on Llama-3-8B-Instruct across different layer groups, using a 4× tokens, 4-bit baseline. The x-axis represents layer groups labeled categorically as Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32, arranged from left to right. The y-axis represents Relative Change on a linear scale, ranging from approximately -15% to 5%, with tick marks at 5% intervals (-15%, -10%, -5%, 0%, 5%). A gray dashed horizontal line represents the baseline of 4× tokens, 4-bit, which remains constant at 0% across all layer groups. The yellow line with circle markers (LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit) starts near 0% at Layer1-4, dips slightly to approximately -1% at Layer5-12, returns to approximately 0% at Layer13-20, remains near 0% at Layer21-28, and rises slightly above 0% at Layer29-32. The red line with square markers (LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit) starts at approximately -1% at Layer1-4, drops to approximately -3% at Layer5-12, stays near -2% at Layer13-20 and Layer21-28, and returns to approximately 0% at Layer29-32. The light blue line with circle markers (RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit) starts at approximately -1% at Layer1-4, drops to approximately -3% at Layer5-12, further decreases to approximately -6% at Layer13-20, recovers to approximately -4% at Layer21-28, and rises to approximately -1% at Layer29-32. The dark blue line with filled square markers (RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit) starts at approximately -1% at Layer1-4, drops to approximately -5.5% at Layer5-12, reaches its minimum at approximately -15% at Layer13-20, recovers to approximately -10.5% at Layer21-28, and rises to approximately -1% at Layer29-32.

x_axis.label: Layer groups (Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, Layer29-32)
